run_sample_goal: run the move_cube_on_trajectory CLI to sample a goal trajectory and print it as JSON
run_goal_from_config: run the CLI goal_from_config command to load a trajectory from a config JSON file
run_evaluate_policy: run the evaluate_policy command to evaluate a policy on random trajectories
run_replay_all: run the replay_all command to replay all evaluation logs in a given directory
run_evaluate_and_check: run the evaluate_and_check command to evaluate a policy then replay and compute rewards
